scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: This primary mouse study characterizes Alzheimer’s disease pathology. Age is used for disease-model characterization, without an explicit analysis or interpretation of an aging process.

causal_design_reviewer.exposure_or_intervention: App SAA knock-in mutations in the mouse App gene
causal_design_reviewer.outcome: Amyloid pathology, neurodegeneration, glial responses, brain metabolism, behavioral phenotypes, and microglial lipid/metabolic alterations
causal_design_reviewer.estimand_or_contrast: Characterization and comparison of heterozygous and homozygous App SAA mice versus wild-type controls across outcomes

evidence_spans.quote: We engineered a novel App knock-in mouse model ( App SAA ) using homologous recombination to introduce three disease-causing coding mutations
Wild type littermate mice were used as experimental controls.
